name: aegis
description: Aegis - a server-authoritative Digimon-style trading card game (React + PixiJS client, Colyseus API).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @aegis/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @aegis/api dev" "pnpm --filter @aegis/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @aegis/shared build && concurrently -n api,web -c green,magenta "pnpm --filter @aegis/api build" "pnpm --filter @aegis/web build"
scripts.test:blue-green-smoke: pnpm --filter @aegis/shared build && pnpm --filter @aegis/api build && node tools/blue-green-smoke.mjs
scripts.ci: pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm test:tools && pnpm -r test
